profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | AI Engineer | Team Leader
profile.summary:
I build the systems behind a virtual card issuing platform - owning design, implementation, and monitoring end to end, with AI woven into the core, not bolted on.

I lead development of issuing features like card lifecycle management, spend controls, tokenization, and real-time authorization, integrating AI-driven fraud detection and anomaly monitoring directly into the transaction pipeline. I work closely with network and processor partners (Visa, Mastercard, Marqeta, Galileo, Lithic) to keep flows secure and compliant, and partner with Product, Risk, and ML teams on authorization rules and customer-facing analytics - from AI-powered dashboards to LLM-driven ops tooling.

I am drawn to problems where payments rigor meets AI experimentation, and I stay close to architecture reviews, incident response, and the fraud and regulatory landscape as the platform scales.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fully responsible for code through design, implementation, maintenance, and monitoring using modern AI tools and frameworks. My roles and responsibilities including:

1. Design, build, and maintain the core systems behind our virtual card issuing platform
2. Integrate AI-powered services for fraud detection, anomaly monitoring, and transaction insights
3. Build APIs and services that power card creation, spend controls, tokenization, and reconciliations
4. Collaborate with Product, Risk, and AI/ML teams to develop machine learning–driven authorization rules and customer-facing analytics
5. Work closely with network partners (Visa, Mastercard) and issuing processors to ensure secure, compliant, and performant issuing flows
6. Act as a subject matter expert on issuing technology and AI-driven enhancements

What You’ll Do:

1. Lead technical development of issuing features: card lifecycle management, spend controls, tokenization, and real-time transaction processing
2. Own integrations with card networks and issuing processors (Marqeta, Galileo, Lithic, or direct to network)
3. Build resilient, observable systems that handle real-time authorization events and sensitive payment data
4. Implement real-time AI-based fraud detection pipelines that learn from transaction patterns
5. Integrate LLM-powered support and operations tooling for internal teams (e.g., automated dispute summaries, transaction anomaly explanations)
6. Build AI-driven customer dashboards showing spend patterns, merchant risk profiles, and cost optimization recommendations
7. Participate in architecture reviews, incident response, and production hardening
8. Monitor and optimize system performance and cost-efficiency as the platform scales
9. Stay current on card network updates, fraud trends, AI advancements, and regulatory shifts

positions.title: SDET Lead
positions.description:
I was working for "Microsoft Advertising Display Ads Platform" project. The main goal of this project is to establish Microsoft as a cross-media advertising leader by entering into traditional and emerging digital media markets, providing a true one-stop, cross-media shop for advertisers, ad agencies, creative houses and ad publishers. 

Display advertising appears on web pages in many forms, including web banners. These banners can consist of static or animated images, as well as inter-active media that may include audio and video elements. Display advertising on the Internet is widely used for branding. This is why metrics like interaction time are becoming more relevant. This may change in the future as display ad-vertising is becoming much more targeted to users, much like how search engine ads can be extremely relevant to users based on what they are searching for. Display advertisers use cookie and browser history to determine demographics and interests of users and target appropriate ads to those browsers.

Responsibilities:
•	Automation framework designing and enhancement activities.
•	Manual and Automation testing
•	Test planning, product analysis and test coverage
•	Setting up the development/test environments
•	Understanding an application architecture and identified design related issues
•	Test plan creation and test execution 
•	Exploratory testing on various browsers like Firefox, Safari, Chrome, IE.
•	Test execution and setup with MTM

projects.title: Kollo
projects.description: Kollo is the next generation task management tool which is closely integrated with VSO. Microsoft is trying to provide more flexibility and power to VSO users with statistical data to analyze item status and progress. In this tool we have mapped VSO project fields with UI and provided different sets of actions across various web pages to Add-remove user, Add followers, Create items with different rules like adding item with assignee, tag s, due date, attach-ment, mark with high impotence etc. Also we have concept of generating feeds for each action performed on relevant VSO items. Overall the intention  of this product is to provide user friendly UI to deal with VSO work items and generate statistic data to understand work-item progress and take quick actions on item to notify creator, assignee and followers..

projects.title: Visual Studio Code
projects.description:
VSCode is a new type of tool (text editor like Sublime and Atom) that combines the simplicity of a code editor with what developers need for their core edit-build-debug cycle. VSCode provides comprehensive editing and debugging support, an extensible model and lightweight integration with existing tools.
Responsibilities: 	
•	Define test strategy and execution plan
•	Adding test cases for Smoke , Functional, integration test 
•	Create test setup for different technologies and platforms
•	Perform localization and accessibility testing
•	Bug tracking, follow up, weekly report and direct interaction with De-velopers and program 
        manager 
•	Performance and load testing across multiple platforms.
•	Writing code snippet across various technologies like (TypeScript, NodeJS, Express, ES6, 
        C#, ASP .Net Core, .NET CLI (Core Command-line) etc.) and verify product behavior for 
        language service, Debug adaptor and other various components.
